derivation: As-of relevance per observation is the recency share 1/(1+ageInDays) of rows strictly earlier than the target timestamp, across all users, normalised by the total earlier weight (Q4, FR-004). Unplayed movies score 0.

MmrSelector runs with the declared lambda 0.5: objective = 0.5*relevance - 0.5*maxSimilarity, ties broken by the lower movie id. Each catalog movie declares exactly one genre, so SimilarityScorer returns 1.0 for two movies of the same genre and 0.0 across genres.

Selection order therefore starts with the highest-relevance movie, then takes the highest-relevance member of each genre group not yet selected, after which every remaining candidate carries the same 1.0 redundancy penalty and follows relevance descending with the lower-id tie-break.
The every-rank hits are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 9, 10; e08 (target 11), e11 (target 9) and e12 (target 12) fall outside the real top 10.
